records.context: ``ops_prefix_minority_min_reads`` (item 967, alpha). From 2 up, a barcode with fewer reads than this is left out of the cell's call when another barcode in the cell has strictly more reads; tied barcodes still block the call. This rescues cells that a single stray read of a second barcode makes ``bad`` under ``'recipe_simple'``; under ``'spacr'`` it changes no call and can only turn ``great`` into ``perfect``. 0 (the default) and 1 change nothing.
